scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof with a reproducible symbolic and numerical checker. Known general integrated-autocovariance and resistance-distance methods are credited. No claim of external or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for a homogeneous ten-state reversible ring with positive first/third-neighbor rates and a binary indicator on two distinct states; neither nonuniform energies nor actual driven-network accuracy is classified. Full text of one older resistance-distance source was inaccessible; possible subsumption by broad weighted-circulant methods remains. Independent audit not performed.
title: A three-threshold placement phase diagram for two-site memory in a ten-state reversible ring
